'''Wawa''' is a [[Mambiloid language]] spoken in a region of [[Cameroon]] and just inside bordering [[Nigeria]] used by about 3,000 people in three main dialects.<ref name="GBS">Gesellschaft für bedrohte Sprachen, "Documenting Wawa – a Mambiloid language in the Cameroon-Nigeria borderland", http://www.uni-koeln.de/gbs/Berichte/Wawa/</ref>

All speakers are [[bilingual]], often in [[Fulfulde language|Fulfulde]].<ref name="GBS"/>

== Further reading ==

* Marieke Martin, ''A grammar of Wawa: an endangered language of Cameroon'', 2012
